evidence.title: README (segment 5)
evidence.excerpt: **Verified parity across ALL four major open VLAs.** Reflex's monolithic ONNX export matches the reference PyTorch policy to **cos = +1.000000** end-to-end on SmolVLA, pi0, pi0.5 (canonical 10-step flow-matching unrolled) and GR00T N1.6 (canonical 4-step DDIM loop external to the ONNX). Per-model first-action max_abs: SmolVLA 5.96e-07, pi0 2.09e-07, pi0.5 2.38e-07, GR00T 8.34e-07 — all at machine precision, shared seeded inputs. Full claim ledger in [reflex_context/measured_numbers.md](reflex_context/measured_numbers.md).

evidence.title: v0.7.2
evidence.excerpt: ## v0.7.2 — A2C2 catastrophic regression eliminated The A2C2 correction head in v0.5.0+ shipped as `partial` after a 2026-04-26 N=50 LIBERO experiment showed catastrophic regression: ON tasks 0+1 = 0/10 vs OFF baseline 8/10. Root cause: unbounded output layer + MSE loss let the head learn magnitude-7 corrections that derailed the policy. v0.7.2 fixes this. After the 2026-04-29 fix: - **N=10 LIBERO ON: 8/10 (80%)** — exactly matches OFF baseline - Chunk correction magnitude: **0.755** (was ~7.0, **9× smaller**) - Catastrophic 0/10 eliminated ### Three architectural changes 1. **Bounded head output** (`kernels/a2c2_correction.py`): `tanh(z/3.0) * 3.0` saturation. Output bounded to ±3.0 in normalized action space. 2. **Huber loss + L2 magnitude penalty** (`correction/a2c2_training.py`): MSE → Huber(δ=0.1) + λ=0.01 magnitude penalty. Caps gradient on outliers, discourages large outputs at training time. 3. **Runtime safety net** (`runtime/a2c2_hook.py`): refuses corrections with chunk magnitude > `sqrt(chunk_size) * 3.0`, falls back to base actions, emits `magnitude_safety_skip` metric. ### Validated - Local sanity: 1000 random extreme inputs, max output L-inf = 0.365 << 3.0 - Modal A…

evidence.title: v0.7.1
evidence.excerpt: ## v0.7.1 — surfaces `--cuda-graphs` with measured perf The `reflex serve --cuda-graphs` flag has been silently in `main` since v0.5.0 (commits `49110d2` → `7dfcab6`, April 24-25). v0.7.1 surfaces it with the Day 8-9 A/B numbers from Modal so users actually know to enable it. ### Measured perf **A100-80GB** (pi0.5 num_steps=10, n=200 paired iterations): | session | OFF mean | ON mean | speedup | OFF p99 | ON p99 | jitter Δ | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | `vlm_prefix` | 93.45 ms | 87.34 ms | 1.07× | 94.33 ms | 87.84 ms | 1.4× tighter | | `expert_denoise` (10× / chunk) | 17.74 ms | 12.04 ms | **1.47×** | 20.91 ms | 12.44 ms (-40%) | **4.1× tighter** | Combined per-chunk: 270.85 → **207.74 ms** = **1.30× speedup**, p99 304 → 212 ms (-30%). **A10G** (n=100 paired): expert_denoise **1.18× mean, p99 -35%, jitter 14× tighter**. vlm_prefix capacity-bounded — gracefully degrades to eager per ADR tier-aware semantics. ### Win shape: predictability > raw mean Robotics control loops care about p99 + jitter more than mean. CUDA graph replay eliminates per-op kernel-launch jitter, which is why the jitter improvements are larger than the mean improvements. `expert_denoise` runs 10× per chunk i…

evidence.title: v0.7.0
evidence.excerpt: Most users now get a **5.55× speedup** out of the box. Measured on Modal A10G (Ampere, sm_8.6) on 2026-04-29 against SmolVLA monolithic, batch=1, 5 warmup + 20 measured forward passes: | Provider | Mean latency | p95 | |---|---|---| | `CUDAExecutionProvider` (silent v0.6.x fallback) | 108.11 ms | 108.68 ms | | **`TensorrtExecutionProvider` (default in v0.7.0)** | **19.49 ms** | 19.71 ms | The 5.55× win was already in v0.5.5's code, but most users silently fell back to ORT-CUDA EP because their installs didn't have `libnvinfer.so.10` + CUDA libs on `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`. v0.7.0 closes that gap. ## What changed - `pip install reflex-vla[serve,gpu]` now pulls `tensorrt>=10` (Linux only). Adds ~2 GB to install — that's the cost of the 5.55× win. `[gpu-min]` extras available as escape hatch. - `reflex/__init__.py` patches `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` AND eagerly `dlopen`s libnvinfer + libnvonnxparser + libnvinfer_plugin + libnvinfer_dispatch + libnvinfer_lean + libcudnn + libcublas with `RTLD_GLOBAL`. Idempotent. Opt-out via `REFLEX_NO_LD_LIBRARY_PATH_PATCH=1`. - `reflex doctor` validates the full TRT EP load chain — 4 new checks with `pip install` remediation hints inline. - README "Performance" sec…
